entity_name: Ministry of Public Works and Transport (وزارة الأشغال العامة والنقل)

facts.value: PRIMARY entity for maintenance and management of Lebanon's national roads, highways, and autostrads.
facts.notes: LLM-RT-002 confirms MPWT (not CDR) is primary for autostrad/highway issues. CDR is primary ONLY when inside an active CDR worksite.

facts.value: Oversees public transportation infrastructure, seaports, airports (coordination), and public works projects not assigned to CDR.
Four Directorates: Roads and Buildings, Land Transport, Civil Aviation, Maritime Transport.
National road network (autostrads, highways). Does NOT cover local/municipal streets.

Ministry website: transportation.gov.lb. Official contact list provides ministry phones and ministry@transportation.gov.lb, but no dedicated national road-repair citizen complaint hotline was clearly published.
facts.human_review_reason: No public complaint hotline identified. Citizen complaint pathway for national road issues unclear. Needs research into MPWT formal complaint channel.

facts.value: No officially published SLA for national road repair. CedarFix target varies by severity: emergency 24-48h, non-emergency 72h-2 weeks.

Boundary between MPWT and CDR jurisdiction for road projects can be ambiguous: CDR executes infrastructure on behalf of GoL but MPWT has ongoing maintenance. Active CDR project = CDR primary; maintenance after project closure = MPWT.
facts.human_review_reason: MPWT vs CDR boundary requires case-by-case assessment for any road that may be part of a CDR project.

hitl_conditions: All national road routing requires HITL due to MPWT/CDR ambiguity
No public hotline confirmed for automated contact
